$comment: Voyz design tokens. Source: the Voyz place-card mockup (design/reference/voyz_place_card_mockup.jpg) and the web prototype (prototype_src/style.css).

lime.use: main accent: CTAs, icon bubbles, active tab, route end point

limeSoft.use: play button inside the audio bar, soft lime fills

limeMid.use: season months rated «good» (between lime «best» and mist «off-season»)

limeLine.use: thin outlines of lime cards and review dividers

black.use: hero, dark sections, tab bar, primary text

paper.use: white sheet over the black hero

routeLine.use: route along the road (white 8 px casing + black 4 px)

font.family: Mulish (Google Fonts, Cyrillic). In the app: expo-google-fonts/mulish
font.logo: VOYZ wordmark: a very wide geometric logotype, drawn as SVG (see prototype_src/app.js → WM). Tagline: «Больше, чем просто поездки»

motion.spring: cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) — on RN: withSpring({ damping: 14, stiffness: 180 })
motion.reducedMotion: turn off parallax, shared element and line drawing; keep a 150 ms crossfade

components.infoGrid: black block, 2×2, 1.6 px border with a lime→white→lime gradient, radius 28; 38 px lime icon bubble + title 16/500 + value 13 muted
components.audioBar: lime pill, height 58, a 46 px limeSoft play circle, «Послушать VOYZ-гид», duration on the right
components.wantCard: white card with a limeLine border; header has a lime→limeSoft gradient; two buttons: lime «Туры и трансферы», mist «Добавить в маршрут»
components.importantCard: olive, white text, ⚠ icon in lime, title «ВАЖНО»
components.changeCard: lime card «ЗАМЕТИЛИ ИЗМЕНЕНИЯ?», white chips, black «Отправить» button
components.rowCard: black 1.5 px outline, radius 22, 64 px thumbnail, small lime circle with an arrow; an index ring on the right
components.tabbar: floating black pill, 68 px, 4 tabs, a lime indicator that slides with a spring
